# sigma_team (Resource)

Manages a Sigma team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_team" "example" {
  name        = "Analytics"
  description = "Analytics team"
  visibility  = "private"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Team description.
- `visibility` (String) Team visibility: `public` or `private`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Team ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the team is archived.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh
terraform import sigma_team.example team-id
```
